messages.subject: For Philippe Pascal | Airports, infrastructure and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Groupe ADP Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Philippe Pascal, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Groupe ADP's international airport portfolio sits at the intersection of governments, aviation authorities, communities, sustainability commitments and major infrastructure operations. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Groupe ADP's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Groupe ADP.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
